validation_metadata.root_cause_of_suspicious_results: 1. PyTorch & transformers dependencies are not installed in the active environment, causing Qwen2.5-VL provider to execute in 0.68ms fallback mode. 2. Tesseract OCR binary is missing from system PATH, causing baseline OCR to emit constant placeholder string 'Image document received and indexed.' 3. Both providers compared ground-truth texts against the same placeholder string, resulting in identical artificial CER (0.9899) and WER (1.0000).
